locations.name: Sather Gate
locations.description: The green arch, stone pillars, and familiar campus entrance.

locations.name: Campanile Field
locations.description: Open lawn portraits, with room to move and views toward the Campanile.

locations.name: Campbell Hall Rooftop/Telescope
locations.description: Rooftop views and telescope portraits. We’ll confirm access when planning your session.

locations.name: Doe Library [Inside/Outside]
locations.description: Choose the exterior architecture and stone railings, or the library interiors. Indoor plans depend on access and photography permissions.

locations.name: Campanile [Around Campus]
locations.description: Different perspectives on the tower from paths, terraces, and campus landmarks.

locations.name: Nature Around Campus
locations.description: Tree-lined paths, leafy backgrounds, and quiet garden corners.

locations.name: Cherry Blossoms
locations.description: Soft blossom-filled backgrounds when the trees are in bloom. Timing and conditions vary.
